mapper.select: SELECT b.pro_name proName, b.pro_provider proProvider, b.pid, r.shareholding_ratio shareholdingRatio, r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement FROM bus_rel_pro b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.from_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'PRO' AND r.to_type = 'ORG' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND r.to_pid = #{pid} ORDER BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC

SELECT b.pro_name proName, b.pro_provider proProvider, b.pid, r.shareholding_ratio shareholdingRatio, r.pid relId, r.rel_category relCategory, r.rel_category_sub relCategorySub, r.rel_status relStatus, r.regulator regulator, r.isValid, r.effectiveDate, r.ineffectiveDate, r.relStatement FROM bus_rel_pro b JOIN bus_rel_pro_psnandorg r ON r.to_pid = b.pid WHERE r.from_type = 'ORG' AND r.to_type = 'PRO' AND r.DELFLAG_ = '1' AND b.DELFLAG_='1' AND r.rel_status='00' AND r.from_pid = #{pid} Order BY r.MODIFIED_TIME_ DESC
mapper.update: update bus_rel_pro set is_Iterate=#{isIterate} where pid=#{pid}
mapper.select: select pro.PID as pid ,pro.PRO_NAME as proName ,rel.PID as relId,rel.SHAREHOLDING_STRAND as holdings ,rel .REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_pro as pro on pro.PID = rel.FROM_PID where rel.TO_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1';

select pro.PID as pid ,pro.PRO_NAME as proName ,rel.TO_PID ,rel.FROM_PID ,rel.PID as relId,rel.SHAREHOLDING_STRAND as holdings ,rel .REL_CATEGORY_SUB as relCategorySub from bus_rel rel left join bus_rel_pro pro on rel.to_pid = pro.PID where rel.FROM_PID = #{pid} and rel.DELFLAG_= '1';

SELECT c1.* FROM bus_rel_pro c1 JOIN (SELECT pro_provider, MAX(CREATED_TIME_) AS max_date FROM bus_rel_pro GROUP BY pro_provider) c2 ON c1.pro_provider = c2.pro_provider AND c1.CREATED_TIME_ = c2.max_date;
